resources.string: Add your Nightscout site to start
Lightkeeper reads glucose from your own Nightscout site and never changes it. Add the site’s address and a readable token in Settings.
The saved address cannot be used. %1$s
Lightkeeper is a secondary display and not a medical device. Always confirm on the primary CGM app.
The token could not be saved on this phone, so nothing was saved. Try again.

Make a readable token in Nightscout: Admin Tools, Subjects, add a subject with the readable role, and copy its access token here. Never paste the API secret: it can change your Nightscout, and Lightkeeper only ever reads. The token stays on this phone, sealed with a key in the Android Keystore, and travels only in a request header, never in an address.
Thresholds change only which word the display shows. They do not affect dosing or the primary app’s alarms. Match them to the alert settings already in the primary app.
